# OOH JAY — Plumbing & Construction

> Specialized Nigerian plumbing engineering and building construction firm based in Lagos. Specializing in high-pressure water systems, plant rooms, pipework manifolds, water treatment, luxury wet areas, and integrated structural building construction across Lagos, Abuja, and nationwide.

## Company Overview
- **Company Name**: OOH JAY Plumbing & Construction
- **Headquarters**: Victoria Island & Ikoyi Corridor, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Service Area**: Lagos (Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Lekki, Ikeja GRA, Eko Atlantic), Abuja (Maitama, Asokoro, Guzape), and nationwide across Nigeria
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: [+234 903 138 6928](https://wa.me/2349031386928)
- **Email**: inquiries@oohjay.com

---

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Plumbing & Mechanical Systems
- Engineered water supply distribution networks utilizing hard-drawn brazed copper, multilayer PPR, and PEX piping.
- Whole-building water treatment, automated reverse osmosis, iron removal, and UV purification systems.
- Variable-speed constant-pressure booster pump stations and plant room manifold arrays.
- Silent acoustic soil, waste, and stormwater drainage stacks.
- 24-hour 16-bar hydrostatic pressure testing prior to closing walls or pouring slabs.

### 2. Sanitaryware & Luxury Wet Areas
- Precision installation of concealed thermostatic mixer valves and walk-in shower systems.
- Multi-layer waterproofing membrane and sealed tanking systems behind tiles.
- Zero-threshold wet rooms and linear trench drains calibrated to exact laser gradients.
- Luxury ceramic, natural stone, and sanitaryware fitting.

### 3. Building & Structural Construction
- Turnkey structural construction handled by in-house building teams.
- Engineered piling, raft foundations, and reinforced concrete framing.
- Direct coordination between plumbers and builders so conduits and pipe sleeves are cast without destructive hacking.

### 4. Plant Rooms, Diagnostics & Servicing
- Central mechanical plant room design, installation, and overhauls.
- Non-destructive thermal and acoustic leak detection.
- Water booster pump servicing, tank chlorination, and ongoing maintenance agreements.

## Featured Projects

1. **Ikoyi Residence (Lagos)**:
   - 3-story cantilevered reinforced concrete estate with subterranean basement and post-tensioned slabs.
   - Built footprint: 750 m². Pressure tested to 16 Bar.
2. **Victoria Island Home (Lagos)**:
   - 7 turnkey luxury en-suite bathrooms with concealed thermostatic valving and acoustic mineral-insulated drainage (<18 dB).
3. **Hydronic System Installation (Eko Atlantic Axis, Lagos)**:
   - Centralized plant room with brazed copper manifolds, dual expansion vessels, and digital booster arrays.
4. **Lekki Peninsula Estate Infrastructure (Lagos)**:
   - Complete estate MEP, subterranean water distribution, and centralized filtration facility serving multiple residential units.

---

## The OOH JAY Engineering Standard

- **Geotechnical Rigor**: Comprehensive soil analysis and borehole chemical testing before structural or plumbing design begins.
- **Zero Concealed Compromise**: All plumbing joints are pressure-tested at 16 bar for 24 continuous hours before walls or floors are closed.
- **Material Sourcing**: Certified Grade 60 rebar, BS 8110-compliant concrete aggregates, copper and PEX from certified manufacturers.
- **Transparent Project Delivery**: Milestone-based deliverables, real-time photographic site logs, and clear bill of quantities (BOQ).
